teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: coffee, tea, water, juice, milk, sugar, cup, glass, café, order, please, thanks

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
coffee, tea, water, juice, milk, sugar, cup, glass, café, order, please, thanks
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I would like an espresso, please (polite drink order)
• With milk or sugar? (asking preference)
• Still or sparkling water? (specifying water type)
• Anything else? (waiter check)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Polite intonation on 'I would like' /aɪ wʊd laɪk/.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Polite intonation on 'I would like' /aɪ wʊd laɪk/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Polite Requests & Modal Structures ('I would like a coffee, please', 'Can I have...?')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Polite Requests & Modal Structures ('I would like a coffee, please', 'Can I have...?')
Controlled Practice:
You want to order a hot tea politely. What do you say?
options: I would like a tea, please.
answers: I would like a tea, please.

elements.content: Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Good morning! What would you like to drink?
B: Hello! I would like a cappuccino and a glass of still water, please.
A: With sugar?
B: Yes, two sugars, please. How much is it?
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to three café customers ordering drinks and write down their orders.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can order hot and cold drinks politely in a café or bar.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can order hot and cold drinks politely in a café or bar.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
